messages:
Ellis (oncall): paging -- alerts firing for StratusCare dedicated pool canary, latency + 5x and a spike of 500 errors from tenant stratuscare-prod-canary. Incident bot: HIGH: dedicated-pool: stratuscare-canary >= error-rate-threshold

Jess (SRE): I see the same in traces — KV cache misses and OOMs on the canary workers. Happens at ~12:14 UTC.

Mike (Platform): rolling canary deployed 2 hours ago to artifact: artefact-2026-03-15-c3. Could be a quantization mismatch.

Anita (ML Infra): possible model variant mismatch with runtime kernels. Quick check: are these canary instances pinned to the new quantized artifact?

Sam (Solutions): Customer reports increased error rates in their dashboards, they called our support line. Need to isolate asap — this is an enterprise VPC tenant.

Ellis (oncall): Plan: 1) Freeze canary traffic immediately 2) Pin StratusCare to previous stable artifact 3) Evacuate canary instances 4) Run smoke tests and confirm customer signals. Agree? :thumbsup:

Jess (SRE): +1. I'll run the freeze now. Command: ```redwood rollout freeze --pool stratuscare-dedicated --selector canary```

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout freeze requested by Jess. Started at 2026-03-15T12:17:03Z.

Mike (Platform): I'll prepare the pin command for the tenant. Recommended stable artifact: artefact-2026-02-28-b7.

Anita (ML Infra): Before pin, we should capture KV cache state and logs for the canary workers: ```kubectl logs -l app=stratuscare-canary -n dedicated --tail=500``` and snapshot /dev/shm usage.

Jess (SRE): Doing logs now. Found repeated failure: "tensor allocator failed: out of memory" and a traceback in the runtime loader. Pushing relevant snippet to our incident folder.

Ellis (oncall): Sam, please notify StratusCare PM (on the call) that we're performing an orchestrated rollback and pin to stable artifact. Keep them updated.

Sam (Solutions): Notified via email + phone. They asked for ETA. Give them ~15-20 min for verification.

Mike (Platform): Executing tenant pin: ```redwood tenant pin --tenant stratuscare --artifact artefact-2026-02-28-b7 --reason "canary regressions" --force```

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: tenant pin job accepted. JobID: 0a9f3c. Will route traffic to pinned artifact once drains complete.

Anita (ML Infra): I'll drain canary workers and scale up stable workers for StratusCare to absorb traffic. Commands: ```redwood pool scale --pool stratuscare-dedicated --replicas 0 --selector canary``` then ```redwood pool scale --pool stratuscare-dedicated --replicas 6 --selector stable```

Jess (SRE): Drain in progress. Noting a few requests still in progress, will wait 30s then force terminate hung sessions.

Ellis (oncall): Handing off to Mike and Anita for the rollback completion check. I'll stay available for coordination. Oncall rotation reminder: Ellis -> Jess in 30m.

Mike (Platform): Pin completed and traffic routed back to artefact-2026-02-28-b7 at 12:29 UTC. Runbook step: validate 200s and latency SLOs for the last 10 min.

Anita (ML Infra): Smoke tests: embedding generation, chat flows, and KV-cache heavy QPS. All green on stable workers. No OOMs observed.

Sam (Solutions): Confirming StratusCare reports errors dropped to baseline. They see request success on their side.

Jess (SRE): Closing freeze and marking incident as mitigated. Commands: ```redwood rollout unfreeze --pool stratuscare-dedicated``` (we will keep the tenant pinned until postmortem).

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: rollout unfreeze accepted.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-STRATUS-1. Severity: sev2. Assigned to Ellis, Jess, Mike.

Ellis (oncall): Postmortem owners: Mike (root cause), Anita (infra fix), Jess (runbook updates), Sam (customer comms). ETA for postmortem draft: EOD today.

Mike (Platform): Initial hypothesis: quantized kernels in artefact-2026-03-15-c3 are incompatible with our eager allocator for certain sequence-length distributions leading to high memory churn. Will reproduce in staging with traffic profile.

Anita (ML Infra): Short-term action: add an allocation guard, and add a guardrail to reject pushes of that quantization profile to dedicated canaries until validated by the compile tests.

Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing timeline and what we did. Will ask for permission to share logs and timeline for their compliance team.

Jess (SRE): Logging final incident note here and linking traces. Moving thread to incidents/2026/STRATUS-1 for retention. 

Ellis (oncall): Thanks team. Will follow up in postmortem channel. :raised_hands:
